UpdateInstallFailed.app_not_located: Pluryprint could not find its own installation to update it.

UpdateInstallFailed.appimage_not_writable: The update could not replace the AppImage because its folder cannot be written to. Move the .AppImage to a folder you own (such as ~/Applications) and try again.

UpdateInstallFailed.package_install_failed: The system package manager could not install the update. Install the package from the releases page instead.
UpdateInstallFailed.previous_app_not_restored: The update failed and the previous version could not be put back. It was kept at “{{path}}”; move it back, or reinstall from the releases page.

sumatra-pdf.remediation: SumatraPDF is missing, so no file can be printed on Windows. Install SumatraPDF, or place SumatraPDF.exe next to Pluryprint.exe.

libre-office.remediation: LibreOffice is missing, so Office, OpenDocument and RTF files cannot be printed. Download it free from https://www.libreoffice.org/download
libre-office.remediationMac: LibreOffice is missing, so Office and OpenDocument files cannot be printed. Download it free from https://www.libreoffice.org/download
libre-office.remediationLinux: LibreOffice is missing, so Office, OpenDocument and RTF files cannot be printed. Install it from your distribution's packages (on Debian and Ubuntu: sudo apt install libreoffice), or download it free from https://www.libreoffice.org/download

chromium.remediation: Pluryprint no longer uses Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome: HTML, Markdown and text files print with the system web view. Resume the job to print it.

pandoc.remediation: Pluryprint no longer uses Pandoc: Markdown files print with the system web view. Resume the job to print it.

heif-codec.remediation: The HEIF image decoder is missing, so HEIC/HEIF photos cannot be printed. Install “HEIF Image Extensions” (and “HEVC Video Extensions” for .heic) from the Microsoft Store. A job paused for it can then be resumed from the queue.

hevc-codec.remediation: The HEVC video decoder this HEIC photo needs is missing. Install “HEVC Video Extensions” from the Microsoft Store. A job paused for it can then be resumed from the queue.

heif-decoder.remediation: No HEIF image decoder is installed, so HEIC/HEIF photos cannot be printed. Install the libheif tools (libheif-examples on Debian and Ubuntu, libheif on Arch; on Fedora, libheif-tools together with libheif-freeworld from RPM Fusion, which decodes HEIC) or ImageMagick. A job paused for it can then be resumed from the queue.

no-heif-decoder.remediation: No HEIF image decoder is available on this system. Convert the photo to JPEG or PNG first.
no-heif-decoder.remediationLinux: No HEIF image decoder is installed, so HEIC/HEIF photos cannot be printed. Install the libheif tools (libheif-examples on Debian and Ubuntu, libheif on Arch; on Fedora, libheif-tools together with libheif-freeworld from RPM Fusion, which decodes HEIC) or ImageMagick, or convert the photo to JPEG or PNG first.

sips.remediation: sips, the macOS image tool, could not be found.

cups.remediation: The system print service (CUPS) could not be started. Check that printing is set up on this computer.
cups.remediationLinux: The system print service (CUPS) is not available, so nothing can be printed. Install the CUPS client tools (the cups-client package on Debian and Ubuntu) and check that the cups service is running.

no-print-backend.remediation: Printing is not available on this platform.

heif-decoder.remediation: No HEIF image decoder is installed, so HEIC/HEIF photos cannot be printed. Install the libheif tools (libheif-examples on Debian and Ubuntu, libheif on Arch; on Fedora, libheif-tools together with libheif-freeworld from RPM Fusion, which decodes HEIC) or ImageMagick. A job paused for it can then be resumed from the queue.
